main_text.p: inani quodam tastu Ecclesia-sticæ potestatis inflati recte & modeste admonentes super-bè, & fastidiosè contempse-runt, & repulerunt: Quare nullam Ecclefiæ firmam pa-cem sperandam puto, nisi ab ijs initium fiat, qui distractio-nis causam dederunt, hoc est, vt ij qui Ecclefiasticæ guber-natioṅi præsunt de nimio illo rigore aliquid remittant, & Ecclefiæ paci aliquid concè-dant, ac multorum piorum votis ac monitis obsequentes, manifestos abusus ad regulam Diuinarum literarum & veteris Ecclefiæ a qua deflexe-runt, corrigant.

page.notes: Left margin blank. Some show-through from the reverse side in the text area; the running head and catchword are as printed. The catchword "Lectori" is printed in spaced capitals and small type at the foot right, reading "LECTORI". Long s rendered as s; ligature st and ct as printed.
